sources.method: Confirms 460 Northwestern Avenue, location across from Electrical Engineering, ground-level Fuel Coffee access, sanctuary on third floor, fellowship hall in basement.

sources.feature: official church history and exterior image
sources.method: History confirms 2017 return to Northwestern Avenue; official image `images/official_ulupurdue_full_building.jpg` supports red-brown brick exterior, three visible storeys, long ribbon-window bays, raised church lettering, and shallow dark roof.
sources.uncertainty: Photo perspective and visible snow obscure some roof and side details; exact dimensions and height are not published.

sources.uncertainty: Page access was blocked for raw capture; facts corroborated by indexed record and church official visit page.
